bullets.text: The COP31 climate summit in Turkey concluded without a major climate deal, as talks exposed deep divisions and a failure to agree on mentioning fossil fuels.

A Russian ship was reportedly attacked by a suspected Ukrainian drone in the Gulf of Finland and later towed away; Libyan officials also reported an explosion on a Russian ship at Benghazi port due to a suspected drone.
A UN report states that one in four women globally are unable to refuse sex within marriage, with almost half of women in west and central Africa lacking this power of consent.
The Greens party in Australia is optimistic about reaching an agreement with the government by the end of the week regarding digital duty of care legislation.
Families of children with epilepsy are concerned about access to essential care after Canberra Health Services decided not to continue employing a paediatric neurologist.
A second fire ant nest, potentially a year old, has been discovered in Sydney, following an initial detection of the invasive insects in September.
Tech suppliers including Dell and HPE are increasing AI server prices by up to 45% months after deals are signed, impacting trading firms.
The American dream of home ownership is receding as mortgage rates surge, with the benchmark rate now over 7%.
Goldman Sachs traders see an attractive entry point in US stocks after a recent selloff, but caution that overall investor positioning remains elevated.
